notes: The search page posts an Elasticsearch-style body to https://www-api.ibm.com/search/api/v2 (appId 'careers', scope 'careers2', lang 'zz', size 30, 'from' for paging). Facets are must[] match clauses on the index's field_keyword_* fields; the API returns the faceted buckets for field_keyword_17/08/18/05, which is where the filter values come from. Confirmed live: must[{"match":{"field_keyword_08":"Software Engineering"}}] narrowed 2818 to 740 jobs, all in that career area. Keyword: the page has a search box but the field its query lands in was not confirmed (sm.query had no effect and match on 'description' returned 0), so keyword_param stays null and keyword filtering is local. Sort clauses are the four the page publishes as a dropdown.
evidence: POST https://www-api.ibm.com/search/api/v2 {"appId":"careers","scopes":["careers2"],"query":{"bool":{"must":[]}},...} -> hits.total 2818 with field_keyword_05/08/17/18 buckets
POST https://www-api.ibm.com/search/api/v2 ... "must":[{"match":{"field_keyword_08":"Software Engineering"}}] -> hits.total 740, all Software Engineering
